code: import axios from'axios';const API_URL="".concat(process.env.REACT_APP_APIURL,"/v1/api/RapidAPI");export const getAllMovies=()=>axios.get("".concat(API_URL,"/Disney/GetAll"));export const changeMovieStatus=(id,status)=>axios.patch("".concat(API_URL,"/Disney/Mongo/changeStatus/").concat(id,"?status=").concat(status));export const searchMoviesFromAPI=name=>axios.get("".concat(API_URL,"/Disney/API/searchFull/").concat(name));export const createMovie=(name,description)=>{return axios.post("".concat(API_URL,"/Disney/save"),{name,description});};export const updateMovie=(oldName,name,description)=>axios.put("".concat(API_URL,"/Disney/Mongo/update"),{oldName,name,description});
